_meta.domain_name: Baseball Player Performance and Statistical Data Management
_meta.definition: The process of recording, analyzing, and managing baseball player performance statistics, fielding data, and salaries.

AllstarFull._description: Captures detailed information about baseball All-Star games, including player participation, team representation, and game details.

columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: gameNum
columns.description: Stores the number of All-Star games a player has participated in.

columns.description: Foreign key linking to the game entity

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: GP
columns.description: Stored are the number of games played by each All-Star player.

columns.name: startingPos
columns.description: Stores the starting position (numeric codes) of each Allstar player.

Appearances._description: Tracks individual player appearances and positions for each game in Major League Baseball seasons.

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: G_all
columns.description: Stores the total number of games played by a player across all seasons.

columns.name: GS
columns.description: Stored are counts of games started by players.

columns.name: G_batting
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player appeared at bat during games.

columns.name: G_defense
columns.description: Stores the number of defensive games played by a player.

columns.name: G_p
columns.description: Stores the number of games played by a player in a season.

columns.name: G_c
columns.description: Stores the number of games a player appeared in.

columns.name: G_1b
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player appeared as a first baseman.

columns.name: G_2b
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player appeared at second base (0 if not played).

columns.name: G_3b
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player appeared at third base.

columns.name: G_ss
columns.description: Stores the number of games started by a player.

columns.name: G_lf
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player led off games for their team.

columns.name: G_cf
columns.description: Stores number of times a player appeared as catcher (G_cf = games played as catcher).

columns.name: G_rf
columns.description: Stores the number of games a player appeared in relief.

columns.name: G_of
columns.description: Stores the number of games played by each player.

columns.name: G_dh
columns.description: Stores the number of games as designated hitter for each player.

columns.name: G_ph
columns.description: Stores the number of games played by a player.

columns.name: G_pr
columns.description: Stores the number of games played by a player.

Fielding._description: Tracks individual player fielding statistics for each season and game, including defensive plays, errors, and assists.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: stint
columns.description: Stores the number of uninterrupted seasons a player spent as a fielding member for a team.

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: POS
columns.description: Stores the position of a player on the field (e.g., P for pitcher).

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stores total games played by each player.

columns.name: GS
columns.description: Stored are the number of games started by a player in fielding positions.

columns.name: InnOuts
columns.description: Records the total number of innings played, including outs made by each fielding player.

columns.name: PO
columns.description: PO column in Fielding table stores the number of putouts by a player.

columns.name: A
columns.description: Stores the number of assists made by a player during a game.

columns.name: E
columns.description: Stores the number of errors committed by a player during a game.

columns.name: DP
columns.description: Stores the number of double plays involved in a game by each player.

columns.name: PB
columns.description: Stored are the number of putouts made by a player in a game (PB).

columns.name: WP
columns.description: Stored are wins above replacement for fielders (WP) as calculated by baseball analyst Bill James.

columns.name: SB
columns.description: Stored are the number of stolen bases by each player in a season.

columns.name: CS
columns.description: Stored are instances of caught stealings attempts against a team during a season.

columns.name: ZR
columns.description: Stored are zeroes for times a player was involved in a double play as a fielder.

FieldingOF._description: Tracks fielding statistics for each player during their stints in a season.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: stint
columns.description: Stores the number of consecutive seasons a player spent as an outfielder.

columns.name: Glf
columns.description: Stored are games played by left fielders in baseball.

columns.name: Gcf
columns.description: Stores the number of games played as a center fielder.

columns.name: Grf
columns.description: Stored are offensive games played by outfielders.

FieldingOFsplit._description: Tracks individual fielding statistics for each position split by game for baseball players in a specific season.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: stint
columns.description: Stores the number of consecutive seasons a player spent as an outfielder.

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: POS
columns.description: Stores the defensive position (LF, RF) for outfielders in baseball games.

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stored are games played by outfielders in a baseball season.

columns.name: GS
columns.description: Stored are counts of games started by outfielders in a baseball season.

columns.name: InnOuts
columns.description: Stores total innings and outs played by an outfielder in a game.

columns.name: PO
columns.description: Stores the number of putouts by left fielders in a baseball game.

columns.name: A
columns.description: Stores the number of assists, putouts, errors, double plays, and games played by an outfielder.

columns.name: E
columns.description: Stores the number of errors committed by an outfielder in a single game.

columns.name: DP
columns.description: Stores the number of double plays made by an outfielder in a game.

columns.name: PB
columns.description: Stored are indicators for outfielders' plays at bases resulting in double plays.

columns.name: WP
columns.description: WP column in FieldingOFsplit table stores win probability added for outfielders.

columns.name: SB
columns.description: Stored are indicators for stolen base attempts by outfielders during baseball games.

columns.name: CS
columns.description: Indicates if a left fielder did not commit an error resulting in a caught stealing opportunity.

columns.name: ZR
columns.description: Stores the number of times an outfielder was not involved in a play (ZR) in LahmanBaseball database.

FieldingPost._description: Tracks individual fielding statistics for each player in a specific game (G, GS, InnOuts, PO, A, E, DP, TP, PB, SB, CS) by team and league during a particular season.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: round
columns.description: Stores round designations for postseason series (WS, NLCS, ALCS) in baseball games.

columns.name: POS
columns.description: Stores baseball field positions such as CF (Center Field), RF (Right Field), P (Pitcher).

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stores the number of games played by a player in their fielding position.

columns.name: GS
columns.description: Stores the number of games a player appeared in as a fielder.

columns.name: InnOuts
columns.description: Records the total number of innings played with outs made by each fielding post.

columns.name: PO
columns.description: Stores the position number of a player in the field during a game.

columns.name: A
columns.description: Stores the number of times a player was involved in a play as a fielder.

columns.name: E
columns.description: Stores the number of errors committed by a player during a game.

columns.name: DP
columns.description: Stores number of double plays involved in a game by each player.

columns.name: TP
columns.description: The TP column in FieldingPost is a boolean indicating if a player was the primary fielder for a particular play.

columns.name: PB
columns.description: Stores the number of putouts made by a player during a postseason game.

columns.name: SB
columns.description: Stores the number of stolen bases successfully executed by a player during a game.

columns.name: CS
columns.description: Stored are instances of caught stealings attempts by fielders.
